title: Did a promise create a republic?
hook: An emperor guarantees fundamental laws. Does that guarantee create a republic?

knows: A promise and its implementation differ.
doesNotKnow: Distinguish the 1809 emperor’s guarantee of fundamental laws from 1919 republican constitutional provisions.

misconception: Yes, protected laws imply a republic
objective: Distinguish the 1809 emperor’s guarantee of fundamental laws from 1919 republican constitutional provisions.
